# Third-party development assets

These assets are temporary production-development stand-ins. Shadowborn's final art direction remains original.

- `shadow_adventurer.gltf` — Quaternius, Ultimate Modular Men Pack, CC0 1.0.
- `grave_wolf.gltf` — Quaternius, Ultimate Animated Animals Pack, CC0 1.0.

Original creator: Quaternius (https://quaternius.com/)

The original license files are preserved beside the assets.

- `shadow_sword.gltf` — Quaternius, Pirate Kit, CC0 1.0. Imported as a temporary sword prop for Checkpoint 01.
